test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

She is painfully __introverted__, but an intelligent girl.
solution: The correct answer is: **Shy** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Introverted **means reserved and preferring solitude. (आरक्षित और एकांत पसंद करते हैं) • **Example**: *Despite being introverted, she excelled in independent work.* • Marked option **Shy **means timid or easily frightened. (डरपोक या आसानी से डर जाने वाला) • **Example**: *His marked shyness made it challenging for him to speak in large groups.* • So, the synonym for 'introverted' is 'shy'. • The sentence suggests that the girl is shy but intelligent. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Outspoken** means someone who speaks their mind freely and openly. (कोई है जो अपने मन की बात खुलकर और स्वतंत्र रूप से कहता है) • **Social** means someone who is outgoing and enjoys being around people. (कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति जो मिलनसार हो और लोगों के बीच रहना पसंद करता हो) • **Bold **means someone who is confident and daring. (कोई ऐसा व्यक्ति जो आत्मविश्वासी और साहसी हो) 40:T749, The correct answer is: "**Everyone was sincerely and positively.**"
